violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cheese sticks and lasagna were not being held hot enough in the hot holding cabinet behind line #2. The cheese sticks were 119º and the lasagna was 120º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. The products were in the unit for 30 minutes. The PIC stated the products would be sold within the next 30 minutes. The unit holding the foods may need to be looked at. CDI.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: There is a gap at the bottom of the back door that leads to the freezer/storage room that will allow pests to enter the establishment when the door is closed.
violations.corrective_action: Please install a door sweep on the outside of the door to seal the gap. When completed, no outside light should be visible at the bottom of the door when looking from inside. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The ambient temperature of the hot holding cabinet behind line #2 was 132º. At other times it was measured at 145º. Other units were 165º and 160º.
violations.corrective_action: The cabinet does not appear to be working/recovering properly and keeping foods above 135º as required. The PIC stated she does not need to use the unit and can use the other three units to store foods. It is recommended that the unit be serviced to ensure it is working properly. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: chicken tenders in two separate hot holding cabinets were 115F and 122F. The holding temperature of the units was set to 135F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. The chicken tenders were reheated in the oven to 165F. The EHS suggested to the person in charge that the holding temperature of the hot holding cabinets be increased to keep foods above 135F as required.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: squeeze bottles of ranch dressing, were not labeled on the self service line.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. The person in charge labeled the bottles during the inspection.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored in buckets of water.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. The buckets were emptied and refilled with a 200 ppm quaternary ammonia sanitizing solution. FALLS CHURCH HIGH SCHOOL (Inspection Date: 10/06/2025) Page 2 of 3
